summary: Frontend e2e UI testing of Medinest completed via Playwright against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. All 14 critical flows from the review request PASSED: landing page (hero/nav/footer), patient login, all 7 patient tabs (Overview/Start/History/CarePlans/Prescriptions/Vitals/HealthTips), full Start Consultation wizard (symptoms → AI triage with GPT-5.2 HIGH urgency for headache+light sensitivity → payment ₦5,000 → mock Paystack success → done), vitals add+chart render, AI health tips (5 cards), logout, doctor login → /doctor, queue shows newly created case, Accept opens ConsultationRoom, chat send works, prescription save toast, doctor notes save, complete consultation → AI care plan generated and redirect to /doctor, admin login → /admin analytics tiles correct (Patients 2, Doctors 1/4, Revenue ₦10,000, Platform share ₦3,000), Approvals tab Approve → 'Doctor approved' toast, RBAC: patient visiting /admin correctly redirected to /patient.

minor.issue: Returns 401 when called from the public Landing page (no token). AuthContext probes /auth/me on every mount, so two 401s appear in console for unauthenticated visitors. Functionally correct (silent catch in AuthContext) but produces noisy console errors on every public page view. Could be suppressed by skipping the probe when no mdn_token in localStorage.

issues: When directly navigating (full reload) to a protected route, ProtectedRoute briefly evaluates user=null between mount and /auth/me resolving. The loading guard handles this with a spinner, but in one slow run the redirect resolved to /login instead of /{user.role} because the route effectively rendered before AuthContext finished. Re-test with enough buffer (4s) confirmed correct /patient redirect. Consider gating ProtectedRoute strictly on `loading || (user && checked)` to eliminate edge case.

action_items: (carried from iteration_1) Block pending/rejected doctors from doctor-only clinical routes via require_approved_doctor dependency.
Optional polish: skip /api/auth/me probe when localStorage has no mdn_token to avoid 401 noise on landing.
Optional polish: ensure ProtectedRoute does not redirect during in-flight /auth/me to harden RBAC redirect race.
critical_code_review_comments: ProtectedRoute correctly redirects mismatched role to /{user.role} and uses loading spinner — implementation is correct; only minor race noted.

PatientDashboard.jsx is 699 lines and contains 7 sub-views + feedback form + wizard inline. Consider splitting Overview, StartConsultation wizard, VitalsView, TipsView into separate files for maintainability (>700 line threshold).
axios interceptor only adds Authorization header from localStorage; backend cookie fallback in place. Acceptable for MVP.
All interactive elements carry data-testid. Toast notifications via sonner verified rendering after prescription save and doctor approval.
